name: Sidfa

queries.query: Sidfa Egypt cadastral parcel map official GIS land registry
queries.result: Discovery found the Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA) first-party site and its digital-map service. The accessible service describes a request-and-purchase workflow for a specified location, scale, layers, format and projection; no public Sidfa parcel viewer/API or bounded parcel response was exposed.

queries.query: صدفا أسيوط خريطة كادسترية سجل عيني أراضي رسمي
queries.result: Discovery found ESA official map/service pages and the Egyptian public-services listing for a land-survey statement. The ESA pages are procedural/service prose only; no anonymous Sidfa parcel layer, schema, CRS, stable native ID or safe geometry response was available.

evidenceSummary: No safe parcel source was admitted. ESA is evidenced as the national survey/cadastral custodian, but its public site exposes map-purchase/service workflows rather than an anonymous parcel feature service. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
notes: The WUP point is preserved exactly in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
No parcel polygon or source-specific attribute set was retained.
This packet records research completion only; it is not source integration or admission.
